ranked.headline: Graph and contrastive models integrate spatial, single-cell and histology omics data
ranked.summary: Spatial, single-cell and histology datasets often have partial or mosaic modality coverage, motivating integration methods that address it directly.

ranked.headline: Computational tools resolve noise and spatial context in single-cell and spatial omics
ranked.summary: Single-cell and spatial datasets now support stage-specific models of regulation, cell fate, disease risk and tissue architecture.

ranked.headline: Learned models steer molecular design toward feasible, affinity-optimized ligands
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs reaction-aware generation with geometric docking and site-aware affinity prediction across the design pipeline.

ranked.headline: Deep models design DNA binders and PROTAC linkers while epistasis gains are challenged
ranked.summary: Learned sequence and structure models are now generating binders and linkers, and benchmarks are testing what these models actually learn.

ranked.headline: Cross-cohort validation tests biomarker generalization across EEG, voice and blood data
ranked.summary: Population-aware and cross-cohort evaluations show that reported biomarker accuracy often drops when models meet unseen cohorts.

ranked.headline: Relational and longitudinal modelling of brain structure and amyloid dynamics
ranked.summary: Methods now quantify brain morphology and amyloid-β progression across lifespan, disease, and genetic axes without relying on single-region summaries.

ranked.headline: Physics-based simulation and scoring applied to binding, coarse-graining and hotspots
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers benchmark free energy methods and extend coarse-grained and fragment-based physics models to structural questions.

ranked.headline: Mechanistic models link noise, regulatory logic, and oscillations to cell dynamics
ranked.summary: Simulation and network models now probe how noise, regulatory logic and coupling shape developmental and neural dynamics.

ranked.headline: Learned models predict receptor-directed molecular behavior from structure and sequence
ranked.summary: Protein language models and AlphaFold3 structures are now paired with activation and interaction data to predict receptor-linked molecular outcomes.

ranked.headline: Label-efficient representations for microscopy and histopathology image analysis
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs weak transcriptomic labels, semi-supervised learning, and specialized architectures to reduce annotation demands in microscopy.

ranked.headline: Simple descriptors often rival deep representations in molecular property prediction
ranked.summary: Benchmarks of larger pretrained and classical models across ADME, toxicity, and PAMPA datasets question whether scale improves molecular prediction.

ranked.headline: Sequence-scale computation infers microbial traits, host links, and viral origins
ranked.summary: Large sequence collections now let computational models link microbial and viral genomes to host disease, taxonomy, gene order, and virus-likeness.

ranked.headline: New graph, autoencoder and language-model methods impose structure on omics data
ranked.summary: Explicit structural models now target single-cell and scATAC-seq data to recover organization flat representations may miss.

ranked.headline: New benchmarks and statistical methods probe bias in omics analysis pipelines
ranked.summary: Recent preprints test whether single-cell, spatial, and microbiome analysis methods generalize and avoid bias or data leakage.

ranked.headline: Conservation-informed deep learning predicts cross-species RBP-RNA binding peaks
ranked.summary: Deep learning models now prioritize functional RNA-binding, regulatory, and non-coding elements directly from sequence, conservation, and multi-omics inputs.

ranked.headline: Structure-informed predictors extend to variant effects and protein interaction sites
ranked.summary: Predicted structures and structure-aware embeddings are now used as direct readouts for missense variant effects and interaction-site prediction.

ranked.headline: Dynamical models link cell plasticity, adhesion and drug effects to spatial organization
ranked.summary: Recent preprints couple phenotypic switching, adhesion and drug-driven dynamics to spatial organization in tumour and tissue models.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks and simulations test inference tools for selection and ancient DNA imputation
ranked.summary: Growing ancient and Neolithic genome datasets make direct benchmarking of local ancestry and imputation tools testable against selection inference.

ranked.headline: Interactive front ends wrap established omics, imaging and mutational scanning analyses
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers offer deployable, code-light interfaces for spatial, proteomic, single-cell and MRI datasets that previously required scripting.

ranked.headline: Chromosome-level assemblies show divergent repeat dynamics and gene loss across lineages
ranked.summary: Multi-genome comparisons of a conifer, aquatic duckweeds and a red macroalga test how repeats and gene loss diverge among related taxa.

ranked.headline: Direct RNA nanopore sequencing resolves single-molecule RNA structure ensembles
ranked.summary: Nanopore single-molecule structure readouts and Bayesian rate inference for reactive RNA now offer uncertainty-aware ensemble characterization.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks and dosage-aware corrections reshape genomic and epigenomic readout calling
ranked.summary: Assembly, benchmarking, and dosage-aware calling studies show reference-dependent choices bias genomic and epigenomic measurements.

ranked.headline: New tools tackle contamination, recombination, and profiling in microbial genomics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and an updated benchmarking platform address scalability, contamination, and classification in bacterial and metagenomic workflows.

ranked.headline: Graph and transformer models infer gene regulatory networks from transcriptomic data
ranked.summary: Public transcriptomes and single-cell perturbation data now train graph and transformer models to recover regulatory and functional gene relationships.

ranked.headline: Pangenome variant calling, VCF simulation, and viral quasispecies comparison tools
ranked.summary: Pangenome references and long-read data are pushing variant calling and benchmarking tools beyond linear-reference workflows.

ranked.headline: Simulation ensembles reveal membrane-dependent conformations and protein self-assembly
ranked.summary: Four 2026 studies apply molecular dynamics to membrane-associated proteins, linking conformational ensembles to membrane binding and assembly.

ranked.headline: Deep learning models advance gene annotation, protein function and metagenome binning
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a publication extend deep learning tools to multi-clade gene prediction, structure-based function annotation and metagenomic binning.

ranked.headline: Rare variants and functional annotations extend genotype-based trait prediction
ranked.summary: Published frameworks now add rare variants and functional annotations to common-variant risk models, improving prediction across populations and traits.

ranked.headline: Biophysical models link ion channel kinetics, neuronal firing and calcium dynamics
ranked.summary: Recent published work pairs hybrid machine learning and inverse modelling with stochastic and geometric biophysical simulation of excitable cells.

ranked.headline: Memory-efficient algorithms for partial order alignment and variation graph construction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers report linear-space POA alignment, lower-memory colored k-mer indexing, and faster pangenome graph construction.

ranked.headline: Open-source in silico tools for primer, docking, and base editor design
ranked.summary: Updated and new open-source in silico tools now cover primer specificity, pocket-based virtual screening, and CRISPR base editing design.

ranked.headline: Backward bifurcation and dispersal diversity govern population persistence and extinction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published model show that persistence and extinction hinge on explicit model structure beyond simple thresholds.

ranked.headline: Dynamics- and geometry-constrained models of noninvasive human brain activity
ranked.summary: Noninvasive EEG and MEG modeling now incorporates neural dynamics and cortical geometry as explicit constraints, alongside systematic architecture evaluation.

ranked.headline: Network and enrichment frameworks for microbial, metabolomic and disease gene data
ranked.summary: Recent work extends network and enrichment frameworks to differential microbial, drug repurposing and metabolomic analyses across disease datasets.

ranked.headline: Computational tools model RNA folding and annotate enzymes from structural motifs
ranked.summary: Preprints present faster RNA folding sampling in memerna, AlphaFold-scale motif annotation, and EHR-molecular diagnosis matching.

ranked.headline: Polymer and sequence-design models probe how DNA sequence shapes 3D chromatin folding
ranked.summary: Coarse-grained and data-driven polymer models now link chromatin fluctuations and sequence design to 3D genome folding.

ranked.headline: LLM agents orchestrate ML and domain tools for PPI, metabolomics and biomedical retrieval
ranked.summary: Agentic platforms now autonomously train PPI predictors, induce readable rules, and ground LLM outputs in deterministic tool execution.

ranked.headline: Chromatin architecture from nucleosomes to multiway contacts shapes regulatory output
ranked.summary: Long-read footprints, kilobase compartments and multiway Hi-C/Micro-C models now resolve regulatory activity at multiple chromatin scales.

ranked.headline: Structure-informed models prioritize zinc-binding and multi-target ligands
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs consensus ML and pharmacophore models with SMARTS libraries and fused target embeddings for ligand prioritization.
